# POST /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/hooks/{id}/tests

Test a push webhook by sending a test push payload

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-323`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| id | path | integer | True |
| ref | query | string | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Webhook or repository not found

## 🛡️ Resiliency

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| idempotency | ✅ configured | low | Each test creates a new hook_task - safe to retry but will create duplicate deliveries |
